info.description: This is a guest management server.
info.title: Guest Management API

post.description: Verifies email and password, and issues an access + refresh token pair.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns a paginated list of event categories. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name, source, tenant_id).

post.description: Creates a new event category. Source must be "app" or "tenant"; tenant_id required when source is "tenant".

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns a paginated list of workflow step templates for an event category. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name).

post.description: Creates a new workflow step template under an event category. order_index must be unique per category.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

409.description: Conflict (order_index already used for this category)

get.description: Returns a single workflow step template by UUID, scoped to its event category.
get.summary: Get workflow step template by ID

put.description: Updates an existing workflow step template by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update); category_id is immutable.

409.description: Conflict (order_index already used for this category)

delete.description: Soft-deletes a workflow step template by ID, scoped to its event category.

get.description: Returns a single event category by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing event category by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update).

delete.description: Soft-deletes an event category by ID.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of events. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (tenant_id, category_id, name).

post.description: Creates a new event scoped to a tenant and category. is_multi_day is derived from start_date/end_date.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns a paginated list of guests for an event. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name, email, phone, rsvp_status); name supports a partial match via "value;like", email/phone only support exact match. Requires the manage_guests permission.

parameters.description: Filter by name — exact, or partial via name=value;like
parameters.name: name

post.description: Creates a new guest under an event; rsvp_status starts at none. ticket_type_id, if provided, must belong to this event. Requires the manage_guests permission.

400.description: Invalid request body or ticket type not on this event

get.description: Returns a single guest by UUID, scoped to its event, including the issued ticket/QR summary once one exists. Requires the manage_guests permission.

put.description: Partially updates a guest's name/email/phone/ticket_type_id. Only provided fields are applied; event_id is immutable. A provided ticket_type_id must belong to this event. Requires the manage_guests permission.

400.description: Invalid ID, request body, or ticket type not on this event

delete.description: Soft-deletes a guest by ID, scoped to its event. Requires the manage_guests permission.

post.description: Requires a ticket type already assigned. Generates an invitation token (returned only in this response — there's no email channel yet) and sets rsvp_status to invited. If the event's rsvp_required is false, also issues the guest's ticket immediately. Requires the manage_guests permission.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of staff assignments for an event. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (user_id, role_id). Requires the manage_staff permission.

post.description: Assigns a tenant user to an event with an event-scoped role. Requires the manage_staff permission.

400.description: Invalid request body, invalid event id, or role_id not event-scoped

404.description: Event, user, or role not found

409.description: User already assigned to this event

get.description: Returns a single staff assignment by UUID, scoped to its event. Requires the manage_staff permission.
get.summary: Get event staff assignment by ID

404.description: Staff assignment or event not found

put.description: Changes an existing assignment's event-scoped role. event_id/user_id are immutable; re-assigning a different user requires removing and re-creating the assignment. Requires the manage_staff permission.

400.description: Invalid ID, request body, or role_id not event-scoped

404.description: Staff assignment, event, or role not found

delete.description: Soft-deletes a staff assignment by ID, scoped to its event. The same user may be re-assigned to the same event later as a new assignment. Requires the manage_staff permission.

404.description: Staff assignment or event not found

get.description: Returns a paginated list of ticket types for an event. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name). Requires the manage_events permission.

post.description: Creates a new ticket type under an event; name is unique per event. The new ticket type defaults to applying to ALL of the event's current workflow steps. Requires the manage_events permission.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

409.description: Ticket type name already exists for this event

get.description: Returns a single ticket type by UUID, scoped to its event, including which of the event's workflow steps it applies to (workflow_step_ids). Requires the manage_events permission.

put.description: Partially updates a ticket type's name/rules. Only provided fields are applied; event_id is immutable. Requires the manage_events permission.

409.description: Ticket type name already exists for this event

delete.description: Soft-deletes a ticket type by ID, scoped to its event. Requires the manage_events permission.

put.description: Replaces the full set of workflow steps a ticket type applies to (full-replace, no incremental add/remove); every workflow_step_id must belong to the ticket type's own event. Requires the manage_events permission.

parameters.description: Full desired set of workflow step IDs
parameters.name: body

400.description: Invalid request body, ID, or a workflow_step_id not belonging to this event

get.description: Returns a paginated list of workflow steps for an event. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name).

put.description: Replaces an event's workflow steps with the given list: entries with "id" are updated, entries without are created, and any existing step not present in the list is deleted.

parameters.description: Full desired list of workflow steps
parameters.name: body

400.description: Invalid request body, duplicate order_index, or an id not belonging to this event

post.description: Creates a new workflow step under an event. order_index must be unique per event.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

409.description: Conflict (order_index already used for this event)

get.description: Returns a single workflow step by UUID, scoped to its event.

put.description: Updates an existing workflow step by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update); event_id is immutable.

409.description: Conflict (order_index already used for this event)

delete.description: Soft-deletes a workflow step by ID, scoped to its event.

get.description: Returns a single event by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing event by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update); tenant_id is immutable.

post.description: Confirms or declines an invitation by its token — no authentication required. Confirming issues the guest's ticket if one hasn't already been issued.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of message templates. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name, source, tenant_id, event_id, channel).

post.description: Creates a new message template. Source must be "app", "tenant", or "event"; tenant_id/event_id required accordingly. Subject is required for "email" channel and must be empty for "whatsapp".

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

409.description: Conflict (e.g. already exists for this scope, name, and channel)

get.description: Returns a single message template by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing message template by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update); the source/channel invariants re-apply to the resulting record.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a message template by ID.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of tenants. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (name, type).

post.description: Creates a new tenant. Settings and branding default to an empty object when omitted.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns a single tenant by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing tenant by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update).

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Query: page, size, sort=field,dir (repeatable), filter by allowed fields (tenant_id, email, role_id, is_tenant_master).

post.description: Creates a new user scoped to a tenant. The password is hashed before storage and never returned.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

get.description: Returns a single user by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing user by ID. Only provided fields are applied (partial update); tenant_id is immutable.

rsvp_required.description:
RsvpRequired defaults to true when omitted — see event_service.go Create.
When false, a guest's ticket is issued at invitation time instead of
waiting on RSVP confirmation (see internal/features/guests).

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login (e.g. "Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...").
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
